claim: A classifier built from the expression levels of 60 genes recognises tumour tissue among new tissue samples with accuracy of at least 0.80.

data_keys.meaning: log expression level of each gene in each tissue sample
True if the sample is tumour tissue, False if normal

claim: A logistic model using 20 baseline markers predicts which patients will relapse within five years, in new patients, with AUC of at least 0.75.

data_keys.meaning: standardised baseline marker values for each patient
True if the patient relapsed within five years

claim: The expression levels of 60 genes predict cancer versus normal status in new tissue samples with accuracy of at least 0.80.

data_keys.meaning: log expression of each gene in each tissue
True if the tissue is cancerous

claim: Patients with leukaemia subtype A can be told from subtype B using 60 gene expression values, with AUC of at least 0.80 in new patients.

data_keys.meaning: log expression of each gene for each patient
True for subtype A, False for subtype B

sizes: 72 patients (47 subtype A, 25 subtype B), 60 genes.

claim: Using 12 country-level indicators, the model identifies which country-years will see a civil war onset, with AUC of at least 0.75 in new country-years.

data_keys.meaning: indicator values, one row per country-year; entries flagged as unobserved hold 0
True where the indicator was recorded
True if a civil war began in that country-year

sizes: 250 country-years, 12 indicators, about 15% onsets and about 20% of entries unobserved.

claim: In a screening cohort where about one sample in five is positive, a nearest-neighbour rule on 30 biomarkers attains balanced accuracy of at least 0.75 on new samples.

data_keys.meaning: standardised biomarker values
True for a positive sample

claim: From 15 clinical measurements recorded in a patient registry, a nearest-neighbour rule predicts diagnosis in new patients with accuracy of at least 0.75. Some patients were entered more than once.

data_keys.meaning: clinical measurements, one row per registry entry
True if the patient has the diagnosis

sizes: 200 rows, 15 measurements; about a quarter of the rows repeat an earlier entry exactly, with its diagnosis.

claim: In a fraud-screening data set where about 12% of transactions are fraudulent, a nearest-neighbour rule on 10 transaction features achieves an F1 score of at least 0.60 for fraud on new transactions.

data_keys.meaning: standardised transaction features
True for a fraudulent transaction

claim: From 8 yearly indicators, the model predicts civil war onset in future country-years with AUC of at least 0.75.

data_keys.meaning: indicator values, one country-year per row, rows in time order
True if a civil war began in that year

sizes: 200 rows in time order, 8 indicators, about 15% onsets.

claim: Using 6 weekly indicators, a ridge regression forecasts next-week hospital admissions in future weeks with R^2 of at least 0.30.

data_keys.meaning: weekly indicator values, rows in time order
admissions in the following week

claim: From 20 image features of tissue patches, the model identifies the gene mutation status of new patients with AUC of at least 0.75.

data_keys.meaning: image features of each tissue patch of each patient
True if the patient's tumour carries the mutation

claim: From 15 patient characteristics, ridge regression predicts length of stay in patients from new hospitals with R^2 of at least 0.40.

data_keys.meaning: characteristics of each patient in each hospital
length of stay in days
